Only main-post edits reach topics.validateTags; editMainPost returns early for non-main posts, yet the claim covers all edits.
createShare's expires request parameter is milliseconds since epoch; ISO 8601/xs:dateTime applies only to the response attribute.

LIMIT is identical, but passing also needs ORDER BY to match; refutation hinges on an order-translation issue unrelated to the limit choice.

Passing a versioned interpreter like /usr/bin/python3.8 to _get_shebang skips ansible_python_interpreter; mechanism lacks versioned-Python handling.
onFinished is wired to the background element; menu-item clicks hit the wrapper's onClick, which only stops propagation.
Pinned go-mssqldb accepts connection strings without a database (only ReadOnly intent needs one), so SQL Server doesn't inherently require a name.
Argparse already underscores optional dests; replacement is needed only for hyphenated positionals, which FnToCLI does create, so refutation is weak.
Core translations load the requested language file directly; missing keys return the backup or key, never en-GB, so no fallback exists.
Baseline configdata.yml qt section has no qt.workarounds.locale (only remove_service_workers); the recalled setting doesn't exist yet.
BASE SendMessage takes no context and handlers drop it; but the agent was restating the PR's required design, not baseline behavior.
TocEntry is a dataclass with subtitle defaulting to None, so chapter.subtitle evaluates to None rather than raising AttributeError.
Verifier says Navidrome follows ReplayGain 1.0, not -18 LUFS; yet the +5 dB R128-to-ReplayGain offset is standard and upstream uses it.
SwaggerParser.validate dereferences and runs schema/spec validation, not just parsing; 'only parses' leaves that out, though examples truly aren't checked.
Unconditional get_iptables_version probe adds a command, but that probe is pre-existing and arguably necessary, so the call-count objection is weak.
middlewares_test.go also assigns MaxAge at lines 184 and 211; the 'only' claim leaves out these test-fixture uses.
A finite TTL only blocks requests inside its window; postDelay is 0 in tests and operations can outlast 1000 ms, so not 'regardless of stagger'.
can returns !disabled && (isAllowed || isAdmin), so admins get false on disabled categories; true only for enabled ones.
Wrong failure type per verifier: baseline run aborts natively ('Fatal Python error: Aborted'), but that abort looks environment-specific, weakening the refutation.
Contact declares many fields (firstName, lastName, company, addresses); agent likely meant no KIND/ANNIVERSARY fields, a qualifier normalization dropped.

Mechanism checks only list emptiness; it omits the required error when Kube.Enabled is false and skipping of invalid public addresses.

render/EORender call mockDomApi during tests, reassigning window.ResizeObserver after setup, which the single-setup requirement forbids; consistency isn't maintained.
Panic happens only on Go 1.16's TLS 1.3 cryptobyte path; the TLS 1.2 marshaler truncates the CA-list length without panicking.
Task requires warnings whenever deprecated keys are explicitly present, including cache.memory.enabled: false; GetBool suppresses that required warning.
Service.Enabled() is true when 'enabled' is omitted; the requirement covers effectively enabled services, so demanding explicit enablement misreads it.
SmartPlaylist exposes Order and Limit as persisted JSON fields and OrderBy is public, so ordering and limit are externally observable.
Only --force-with-deps (force_deps) bypasses the skip; a --force-only run still skips same-version dependencies, so 'unless forced' is too broad.
With runpy alter_sys=True, sys.argv[0] inside the module is the module's __file__, not the on-disk AnsiballZ wrapper.
